key_points: FAA reportedly halts 737 MAX 10 certification, putting ~31% of undelivered orders at risk
New software glitch discovered in 737 MAX flight guidance system adds to quality concerns
Stock fell ~7% on Sep 28 on the certification delay news
Positive offset: tentative 4-year union deal with 17,000 engineers removes labor overhang
Defense win: $2B satellite contract provides diversification but doesn't offset commercial jet risk
